verdict.rationale: Sprinto's documented webhooks are inbound only. They give external systems a unique endpoint URL to push data into Sprinto and trigger ingestion workflows (sprinto-docs-27, sprinto-docs-48, sprinto-docs-49). The pack shows no way to subscribe to Sprinto's own events, such as control failures, alerts or task changes, delivered to an external endpoint; the only notification-subscription evidence is email alerts on the status page, not webhooks. Outbound event webhooks are a reasonable thing to ask of a compliance SaaS platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows it is delivered.
